entries.title: Psalms 48:1
segments: A Song and Psalm for the Sons of Korah. Great [is] the LORD, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, in the mountain of His holiness.

entries.title: Psalms 48:2
segments: Beautiful on high, the joy of the whole earth, [is] mount Zion, on the sides of the north, the city of the great King.

entries.title: Psalms 48:3
segments: God is known in her strongholds for a refuge.

entries.title: Psalms 48:4
segments: For, lo, the kings were gathered; they passed by together.

entries.title: Psalms 48:5
segments: They saw, so they marvelled; they were troubled, [and] hurried away.

entries.title: Psalms 48:6
segments: Fear took hold on them there, [and] pain, like a woman in labor.

entries.title: Psalms 48:7
segments: You break the ships of Tarshish with an east wind;

entries.title: Psalms 48:8
segments: as we have heard, so we have seen in the city of the LORD of hosts, in the city of our God. God will establish it forever. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 48:9
segments: We have thought of Your loving-kindness, O God, in the midst of Your temple.

entries.title: Psalms 48:10
segments: According to Your name, O God, so [is] Your praise to the ends of the earth. Your right hand is full of righteousness; let mount Zion rejoice!

entries.title: Psalms 48:11
segments: Let the daughters of Judah shout for joy because of Your judgments!

entries.title: Psalms 48:12
segments: Walk around Zion, and go all around it; count the towers of it,

entries.title: Psalms 48:13
segments: Set your heart on its ramparts, pass between its strongholds; so that you may tell [it] to the coming generation.

entries.title: Psalms 48:14
segments: For this God [is] our God forever and ever; He will be [our] guide [even] to death.
